title: Pink-haired Warrior Poses
description: Four identical side-by-side panels showing a female character with pink hair in pigtails, wearing green and black armor with a cape and crown. She is in a dynamic combat stance with one arm raised and the other extended, blowing a pink bubblegum bubble against a solid green background.
prompt: A female warrior with voluminous pink hair in high pigtails and a small crown, wearing dark green and black fantasy armor with shoulder pads, a flowing cape, and heavy boots. She stands in a dynamic action pose with one hand raised and the other forward, blowing a large pink bubblegum bubble. Four identical panels arranged horizontally against a solid vibrant green background, cartoon style, clean lines, vibrant colors.
